module: "Extensions Editor" window of the editor: lists all editor extensions (editor.allExtensionNames) and lets you enable/disable their loading by clicking the icon. The state is stored in editor.extensionsSettings[name].disabled then saved by editor.saveExtensionsSettings(). A Lua reload (Ctrl+L) is needed to apply the change; the editor's safe mode (Ctrl+F11) lets you disable a faulty extension.

onEditorGui.desc: Draws the window: help text and a one-column table with an icon button per extension (check mark = enabled, red "do_not_disturb" icon = disabled). A click toggles the disabled flag and saves the settings.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Registers the "extensionsEditor" window (size 915x600) and the "Extensions Editor" menu entry.
